description: This file is a server-side route for a SvelteKit application handling organization selection and user data fetching from a Django REST API backend. It manages user session cookies, fetches user organizations, and allows switching organizations by interacting with Django endpoints.

methods.name: load
methods.description: Server-side load function that fetches the current user's organizations from the Django API and returns them for page rendering.

methods.name: selectOrg
methods.description: Action handler that processes the organization selection form, switches organization context via API, updates cookies, and redirects.
